svg.title: Pacific North Subsurface Countercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 5000 km. Declared northern Tsuchiya Jet studied reach from the 155 W mean-section core to the 110 W mean-section core. Western formation and basin continuation east of 110 W are excluded. The section gates truncate a larger current; interpolating bends are editor-selected, not a measured continuous centerline or particle path. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate 155 W to 110 W northern Tsuchiya reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Johnson & Moore (1997); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
